description: Access token contents and lifetime: subject, capability claims, expiry, tamper rejection.

cases.inputs: User: active Secretary "Nguyễn Thư Ký" <thuky@trustcabinet.local>; capabilities: [MeetingCreator, MinutesEditor].
preconditions: Signing key configured (test key); issuer and audience TrustCabinet; lifetime 15 minutes.
Test user Nguyễn Thư Ký with known id and email.
cases.return: Signed JWT with claims sub (user id), jti (unique), email, name, and one "cap" claim per capability: [MeetingCreator, MinutesEditor]; no role claim.

cases.inputs: User: active Secretary "Nguyễn Thư Ký" <thuky@trustcabinet.local>; capabilities: [].
preconditions: Signing key configured; test user Nguyễn Thư Ký.

cases.inputs: Same user and empty capabilities; called twice.
preconditions: Signing key configured; test user Nguyễn Thư Ký.
cases.return: Two signed JWTs with different jti values.

cases.inputs: User: active Secretary "Nguyễn Thư Ký"; AccessTokenMinutes: 5.
preconditions: Signing key configured with a 5-minute access token lifetime.
cases.return: Signed JWT expiring about 5 minutes after creation.

cases.inputs: Token created for the Secretary; validated with a different signing key.
preconditions: Signing key configured; test user Nguyễn Thư Ký.
cases.return: Signed JWT that the validator accepts under the signing key and rejects under any other key or after tampering.

preconditions: Signing key configured; test user with a known password hash.
cases.return: Signed JWT whose raw text does not contain the password hash.
